name: Core2

validation.concurrency_validation: Two independent two-instance no-stagger 4x120s gates pass 8/8, two independent three-instance 3x120s gates pass 6/6, and two independent four-instance 4x120s gates pass 8/8. Patch 0008 preallocates real guest HCI-event buffers and ACL mbufs while CPU0 is idle; patch 0009 expands the real reserve to 8 event/4 ACL objects after the initial four-instance gate failed 1/4. Every passing lease records 36 events/9 ACLs on the fast path, HLI 45/45, hli-errors=0 and the expected spare depth. Two independent five-instance 5x120s batches with a 30-second startup stagger pass 10/10. The earlier shift=auto zero-stagger implementation remained unstable: one batch passed 5/5 and an independent confirmation failed 3/5. Trace evidence showed that HLI events were queued while CPU0 had interrupts disabled during PSRAM initialization, and shift=auto stretched guest scheduling under host contention so delivery missed the NimBLE ACK window. In the historical 0010 5x20s diagnostic batch, the first Reset Complete response-to-HLI timestamp delta was 4.506306s of host trace time, not guest virtual time; at the first ACK check ack=NULL and semaphore count 0, and 0010 remains opt-in observability only. The current default fixes icount shift=5, and the unified harness starts its test BLE server before WiFi and sustained PSRAM work. With that implementation, two independent zero-stagger five-instance 5x120s batches pass 5/5 each (10/10 total), maximum concurrency 5. Each lease passes WiFi DHCP/HTTP, public DNS/HTTP, external NUS GATT, frame, 31-node QOM, pcap, evidence and 14-15 full 1 MiB PSRAM readback sweeps; HLI is 45/45, C2H is 36 events/9 ACLs, and errors/reset/panic/dropped/queue depth are 0. The reconnect contract remains 1-121 with 122 rejected. More than five instances, sustained throughput and teardown modes beyond active-stop remain OPEN.
validation.memory_validation: The m5core2 machine now exposes a QOM-effective 8 MiB PSRAM device. Normal ESP32 DRAM1 remains a 4 MiB directly mapped heap window; a dedicated ESP-IDF esp_himem probe passed in three independent Device Service leases, mapping two different 32 KiB physical blocks through the same virtual MMU window and verifying both after remap (4,456,448 bytes himem capacity, 262,144-byte reserve). Guest sustained stress remains PASS in three independent 120-second leases (35/35/35 checks, 105 MiB total) and one 600-second lease (179 checks). Physical PSRAM/cache timing remains NOT RUN.
validation.detail: 官方 UIFlow2 v2.5.3 在同一 m5core2 guest 内通过 320x240 显示/触摸、AXP2101、INA3221、MPU6886、PCF8563、NS4168 扬声器、SPM1423 麦克风、OpenMAC WiFi DHCP/HTTP、example.com IPv4 DNS/HTTP 和 stock firmware 外部 BLE GATT。规范 Device Service profile `core2-native-hci` 已通过 HCI-4、121 轮重连、active-BLE 长稳、active-stop 和 bounded TCG。m5core2 machine 现以 8 MiB PSRAM device 和 DRAM1 32 KiB MMU 页映射运行；三个独立 esp_himem lease、三个 120 秒 guest PSRAM 压力和一次 600 秒联网压力均 PASS。最终 `tb-size=128` 两小时复测绑定 firmware/ELF/QEMU/工具哈希，RSS 323536→252992 KiB、phys footprint 250880→188416 KiB。四实例首批 4×120s 的 1 PASS / 3 FAIL 保留，0009 扩为 8 event/4 ACL 后两批四实例均 8/8 PASS。旧 `shift=auto` 零错峰五实例曾出现一批 5/5 PASS、独立批 3/5 FAIL；trace 证明失败窗口内 CPU0 在 PSRAM 初始化时关闭中断，HLI 虽已入队却错过 NimBLE ACK 预算。当前默认固定 `shift=5`，统一 harness 将测试 BLE server 提前到 WiFi 和长 PSRAM 压力前；两批独立零错峰 5×120s 随后均 5/5 PASS，合计 10/10，最大并发 5。每个 lease 完成 WiFi/公网 DNS/HTTP、外部 NUS GATT、frame、31 节点 QOM、pcap、evidence 和 14–15 次 1 MiB PSRAM 全缓冲校验；HLI 45/45、36 events/9 ACLs，errors/reset/panic/dropped/queue depth 均为 0。旧 `core2-native-vhci` 仅保留为 GDB 诊断/兼容路径。物理 cache/PSRAM、大于五实例、持续吞吐、其他 teardown 模式与 Espressif BT baseband/controller bit-exact 执行仍未完成。
